amendment: For a calibration segment whose candidate human scores are all equal, retain the segment and assign every action zero centered standardized quality.
calibration_outcome_access: The second calibration attempt loaded calibration scores and stopped before computing any policy decision when it encountered at least one constant-quality segment.
evaluation_outcome_access: No evaluation candidate quality, policy comparison, or decision regret was computed during this repair.
justification: A constant-quality segment provides zero evidence for preferring one candidate or policy over another. A zero centered row is its exact contribution to every calibration gain and avoids both outcome-dependent exclusion and division by zero.
scope: Numerical definition for constant calibration rows only. The split, policies, pressure grid, selectors, baselines, success criteria, and evaluation procedure are unchanged.
